column2: Assessing Bias in Metric Models for LLM Open-Ended Generation Bias Benchmarks
column6: Fetched (landing page thin; confirmed via arXiv 2410.11059, Holistic AI + Stanford + UCL, Demchak/Guan/Wu/Xu/Koshiyama/Kazim). Qualifying methodology finding (1.0 cat 2): two experiments on MGSD using counterfactuals + SHAP show the classifier/metric models used to score open-generation bias benchmarks (BOLD, SAGED) themselves treat demographic descriptors unequally, biasing benchmark conclusions. Named in-scope evaluator, evidence-backed measured result. No existing report_id maps -> candidate miss.

column2: LibVulnWatch: A Deep Assessment Agent System and Leaderboard for Uncovering Hidden Vulnerabilities in Open-Source AI Libraries

Qualifying methodology/tooling + empirical finding: deep-assessment-agent system scoring named open-source AI libraries and surfacing hidden vulnerabilities via a public leaderboard. Named in-scope evaluator. No existing report_id maps -> candidate miss.

column2: Mind the Gap: Evaluating Model- and Agentic-Level Vulnerabilities in LLMs with Action Graphs
column6: Fetched (arXiv 2509.17259, Holistic AI). Qualifying empirical model findings: action-graph red teaming measured GPT-OSS-20B at 39.47% and Gemini-2.0-flash at 50.00% model-level attack-success rate, with tool-calling actions 24-60% higher ASR at agentic level -- a model- vs agentic-level gap. Named models, Holistic-asserted measured results. No existing report_id maps -> candidate miss.

column2: AgentGraph: Trace-to-Graph Platform for Interactive Analysis and Robustness Testing in Agentic AI Systems
column6: Fetched (full abstract). Observability/tooling platform paper: converts agent execution logs into interactive knowledge graphs and describes a capability for quantitative robustness evaluation via perturbation testing, but reports no measured robustness result on any named model. Tooling description, no finding per 1.0 (cf. no measured result carried).

column2: AgentSeer: Visualizing and Evaluating Temporal Actions in Agentic AI Systems
column6: Fetched (landing page thin; confirmed via AAAI-26 proceedings ojs.aaai.org/index.php/AAAI/article/view/42392, Holistic AI/Wicaksono). Demonstration of an observability/visualization tool that enables action-level red teaming on a six-agent hierarchical testbed; presents tool capability, not a distinct named-model measured finding. The underlying empirical action-graph red-teaming results belong to the earlier/fuller Mind the Gap paper (this slice, INCLUDED). No qualifying finding per 1.0.
